categories.hint: Check the objective cards (hidden) at the end

categories.label: Survived and reached Earth
categories.hint: Alive and returned to Earth (in hibernation counts only if rules allow; verify)

categories.label: Player wins
categories.hint: Wins individually; none, some or all may win

winCondition: Players win individually: survive to the end of the ship's journey and arrive at Earth with their personal objective(s) fulfilled. None, some or all players may win. Exact conditions (hibernation, rescue, objective timing, coop and solo modes) not verified against the rulebook.

endCondition.description: Game ends after the final turn on the round track, when the ship reaches Earth

notes: family: semi-coop-objective. No points. Not verified against the official rulebook (could not download it). Cooperative and solo modes differ and are not modelled; the 15-turn figure is from Wikipedia and should be re-checked.
